author: Kif Leswing
title: Apple strongly denies bombshell report that Chinese spies were able to secretly implant chips in its servers (AAPL)
text: Apple strongly denies bombshell report that Chinese spies were able to secretly implant chips in its servers (AAPL) By Kif Leswing Oct 4, 2018, 4:47 pm 18 pts Chinese spies were able to add small, undocumented chips to motherboards in data servers bought by big US tech companies, according to a blockbuster investigation by Bloomberg published Thursday.
